_about: Generated by pipeline/scripts/joints.py. Bone names are the Z-Biomechanics rig names, unchanged. Movement axes are unit vectors in the bone REST-local frame; a positive angle performs the named movement (measured by posing, see check). Angles are relative to REST = anatomical position.

coordinates.blender: metres, +Z up, anterior -Y, subject left +X; bone-local Y runs head->tail
coordinates.three: after glTF Y-up export: (x,y,z)_three = (x, z, -y)_blender -> up +Y, anterior (the body faces) +Z, subject left +X
coordinates.axis_three: bone-local axis in three.js == axis_local (the exporter converts world space only, bone-local frames are unchanged); verified by check.mjs

fixups.note: Unsuffixed hand/foot phalanx and metacarpal mesh names are right, .001 left; "Third metacarpal bone.l" is right. In the full file the .l objects are the mirrored (negative-scale) copies.

breath_note: Breath = rotation of each RibN-Start.{l,r} about its bone-local X scaled by the share (from the rig). Sign/magnitude not yet measured -> open.

pose_probe.note: Posed in Blender by joints.py; check.mjs repeats it in three.js and compares tails.

shoulderGirdle.r.note: Clavicle-X.r (child) is also free; the scapula and arm ride on the clavicle.

horizontalAdduction.compose: outermost: q = q_hAdd * q_flexion * q_abduction * q_rotation

elbow.r.note: flexion on RightForeArm carries radius + ulna; pronation turns Radius.r about its own long axis (approximation of the radio-ulnar axis)

shoulderGirdle.l.note: Clavicle-X.l (child) is also free; the scapula and arm ride on the clavicle.

horizontalAdduction.compose: outermost: q = q_hAdd * q_flexion * q_abduction * q_rotation

elbow.l.note: flexion on LeftForeArm carries radius + ulna; pronation turns Radius.l about its own long axis (approximation of the radio-ulnar axis)

breath.note: One entry per rib (rib<N>.<side>): axis lifts the rib front; share = the rig's breath share. src/core turns breath.amount (0..1) into share * amount * breath_max_deg about each axis.

helpers_note: Bands helpers (pipeline/scripts/bands.py). Each frame: carry the helper with its parent, swing its stretch axis (bone-local +Y, head to tail, in Blender and three alike) onto the target bone's world position, scale that axis by s = distance / rest_length and the volume axis (bone-local Z) by 1/s. The target bones (MT_*) do not deform; they only mark the insertion point on the scapula.
